map.如何使用冥想计时器？: How do I use Meditation Timer?
map.冥想计时器适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Meditation Timer best for?
map.冥想需要一个安静的倒计时。设置总时长与每段间隔，自动生成分段计划，附 4-7-8: Meditation needs a quiet countdown. Set the total duration and segment interval to auto-generate a segment plan, with a 4-7-8 breathing rhythm reference.
map.分段数 = 总时长 ÷ 单段时长；4-7-8 呼吸一轮 = 吸气 4 s + 屏: Segment count = total duration / segment duration; one 4-7-8 breathing round = inhale 4 s + hold 7 s + exhale 8 s = 19 s
map.冥想计时把总时长均分为若干段并在段末给出提示音；4-7-8 呼吸法以吸气 4 秒: The meditation timer splits the total duration into segments and gives a cue at each segment end; the 4-7-8 breathing method uses inhale 4 s, hold 7 s, exhale 8 s per round (~19 s), and by lengthening the exhale it activates the parasympathetic nerve to aid relaxation; beginners can start from 4-4-6 to avoid discomfort from holding too long.
map.正念冥想：设总时长，安静: Mindfulness meditation: set the total duration, quiet
map.呼吸练习：用 4-7-8 呼吸法节奏（吸 4 秒、屏 7 秒、呼 8 秒）放松助: Breathing exercise: use the 4-7-8 rhythm (inhale 4 s, hold 7 s, exhale 8 s) to relax and aid sleep.
map.分段计划：把长时段拆成若干小段，每段提示切换姿势或关注点。: Segment plan: split a long session into small segments, each cueing a posture switch or focus point.
map.设置总时长与每段间隔，工具自动生成分段计划并在每段结束提示；内置 4-7-8 呼: Set the total duration and segment interval; the tool auto-generates a segment plan and cues at each segment end; built-in 4-7-8 breathing: inhale 4 s -> hold 7 s -> exhale 8 s, 19 s per round. Data is local, no upload.
map.总 10 分钟、每段 2 分钟：分 5 段，每段结束轻提示切换；4-7-8 呼吸: Total 10 minutes, 2 minutes per segment: 5 segments, a light cue at each end to switch; 4-7-8 breathing done 4 rounds ~ 4x19 = 76 s. Beginners should start at 5 minutes with halved holds to avoid breath-holding discomfort.
map.4-7-8 呼吸法有什么用？: What is the 4-7-8 breathing method for?
map.通过拉长呼气与屏息激活副交感、放缓心率，常用于助眠与焦虑缓解；心肺疾病者请遵医嘱: By lengthening exhale and hold it activates the parasympathetic, slowing the heart rate, often used for sleep and anxiety relief; those with heart/lung disease should follow medical advice and not force holding.
map.不必。连续一个长时段也可；分段只帮你保持觉察、防止走神过久。: No. A single continuous long session is fine; segmentation only helps you stay aware and avoid drifting too long.
map.间隔提醒按总时长均分，每段结束时回到呼吸: Interval reminders split the total evenly; return to breathing at each segment end
map.4-7-8 呼吸法：吸气4秒-屏息7秒-呼气8秒: 4-7-8 breathing: inhale 4 s - hold 7 s - exhale 8 s
map.冥想非医疗手段，严重焦虑/失眠请就医: Meditation is not medical; for severe anxiety / insomnia see a doctor
map.建议手机静音，用振动或柔和提示音: Mute the phone, use vibration or soft cues
